title: Improved Bootstrap Inference for Dynamic Panel Data models with Interactive Effects
abstract: arXiv:2609.31442v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study recursive-design wild bootstrap inference for dynamic panel data models with unobserved common factors estimated by Common Correlated Effects. In the large N,T setting, the bootstrap reproduces the biased limiting distribution in pure autoregressive models, but fails to capture all bias and factor-estimation variance components in models with additional regressors, particularly under weak exogeneity. We trace this failure to holding regressors fixed across bootstrap replications. We propose to combine bootstrap procedure with available bias-correction methods to conduct adjusted inference. Monte Carlo evidence shows substantial improvements over conventional strategies of using bias-correction paired with cross-sectional bootstrap methods.

translated_title: 具有交互效应的动态面板数据模型的改进Bootstrap推断
translated_abstract: 我们研究了通过共同相关效应方法估计不可观测共同因子的动态面板数据模型的递归设计野Bootstrap推断。在N和T都较大的情形下，该Bootstrap方法能在纯自回归模型中再现有偏的极限分布，但在包含额外回归变量的模型中（尤其是在弱外生性条件下），无法完全捕捉偏差和因子估计方差成分。我们将这一失败归因于在各次Bootstrap重复中保持回归变量固定不变。我们提出将Bootstrap程序与现有的偏差校正方法相结合，以进行修正后的推断。蒙特卡洛模拟证据表明，相较于将偏差校正与横截面Bootstrap方法相结合的传统策略，该方法有显著改进。
tldr: 该论文发现传统递归设计野Bootstrap在含额外回归变量的动态面板交互效应模型中无法捕捉全部偏差和因子估计方差，并提出将其与偏差校正方法相结合进行修正推断，蒙特卡洛模拟显示该方法显著优于传统策略。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that recursive-design wild bootstrap fails to capture all bias and factor-estimation variance in dynamic panel models with interactive effects and additional regressors, and proposes combining the bootstrap with bias-correction methods, which Monte Carlo evidence shows substantially outperforms conventional strategies.
